ac:rich-text-body.p: This page is part of the company Database Security Configuration Policy (SEC-POL-DB-001). Its requirements are mandatory for every database in scope. Deviations need an approved entry in the DB Security – Exceptions Register. CIS Benchmarks and Tenable audit files are the technical basis and assessment method; where this policy differs from CIS, this policy applies.

ul.li: Apply database-level controls to the CDB root and to every PDB. State in Comments if a control is CDB-only.
Listener and sqlnet.ora controls are checked through the Unix (SSH) part of the scan on the database host.
Oracle Autonomous / managed cloud services: controls the provider manages are N/A; record them in Comments.

td.p: Policy Compliance Auditing (credentialed)
CIS_Oracle_Database_19c_*.audit (database checks) + CIS Unix audit for listener / file checks
Database credential, type Oracle (SID or service name; scan each PDB as well as the CDB)
CREATE SESSION, SELECT ANY DICTIONARY (or SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE), AUDIT_VIEWER; no DBA role
Company values from the register below override CIS defaults in the tailored audit file. Store it in [repository / Tenable policy name]

ul.li: One row per control. Control IDs are never renumbered or reused.
Tenable Check describes what the audit item reads and its pass condition. Copy the CIS section from the audit item's reference field into CIS Reference.
Changing a Compliant Value is a policy change: record it in the change log and get approval.
After every scan, update Compliance % and Open CRITICAL / HIGH in the table at the top of the page.

td.p: Supported release with current Release Update
The database runs a release under Oracle Premier or Extended Support with a Release Update no older than the previous quarterly CPU.
Latest or previous quarterly RU in DBA_REGISTRY_SQLPATCH
SELECT banner_full FROM v$version and latest DBA_REGISTRY_SQLPATCH entry; compared with the approved RU list
Tenable reports the version; the approved RU list is maintained by the DBA team.
No default passwords
No account may use an Oracle default password. Unused Oracle-supplied accounts are locked and expired.
SELECT * FROM dba_users_with_defpwd returns no rows
Query DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD; FAIL on any row
Password and lockout profile
Every profile used by a non-service account enforces the corporate password standard and a verify function.
FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS ≤ 5, PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME ≥ 1, PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME ≤ 90, PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX ≥ 10, PASSWORD_GRACE_TIME ≤ 5, PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION not NULL
Query DBA_PROFILES for each profile assigned in DBA_USERS
Service accounts use a separate profile with no expiry; their passwords are rotated by PAM.
Remote OS authentication disabled
The database must not trust the client operating system to authenticate users or roles.
REMOTE_OS_AUTHENT / REMOTE_OS_ROLES = FALSE, OS_ROLES = FALSE
Query v$parameter
Password file restricted
Remote SYSDBA logon through a password file is allowed only where a documented need exists (e.g., Data Guard).
REMOTE_LOGIN_PASSWORDFILE = NONE, or EXCLUSIVE with an approved exception
Query v$parameter
No PUBLIC execute on network and file packages
PUBLIC must not have EXECUTE on packages that read files, open network connections or run dynamic SQL / Java.
No PUBLIC grant on UTL_FILE, UTL_TCP, UTL_HTTP, UTL_SMTP, UTL_INADDR, DBMS_JAVA, DBMS_SCHEDULER, DBMS_LOB
Query DBA_TAB_PRIVS WHERE grantee='PUBLIC' for the package list
Powerful privileges restricted
*ANY* system privileges, DBA, and administrative privileges (SYSDBA, SYSOPER, SYSBACKUP…) are granted only to approved accounts.
Grantees in DBA_SYS_PRIVS / DBA_ROLE_PRIVS / v$pwfile_users match the approved list
Tenable lists grantees; reviewer compares with the approved list
Tenable cannot know the approved list; record the review outcome here.
Security initialization parameters
Security-related initialization parameters are set to the company values.
SEC_MAX_FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS ≤ 3, SEC_PROTOCOL_ERROR_FURTHER_ACTION = (DROP,3), SEC_RETURN_SERVER_RELEASE_BANNER = FALSE, SQL92_SECURITY = TRUE, _TRACE_FILES_PUBLIC = FALSE, RESOURCE_LIMIT = TRUE
Query v$parameter / x$ksppcv for hidden parameters
Sample schemas removed
Sample schemas (HR, OE, SH, PM, IX, BI, SCOTT) are not installed in production databases.
No sample schema in DBA_USERS
Query DBA_USERS
Listener hardened
The listener cannot be reconfigured at run time and does not offer external procedures.
ADMIN_RESTRICTIONS_<listener>=ON in listener.ora; no EXTPROC entry
Unix audit: content check on $ORACLE_HOME/network/admin/listener.ora
Network encryption required
All client connections are encrypted with TLS or Oracle native network encryption.
SQLNET.ENCRYPTION_SERVER = REQUIRED, SQLNET.ENCRYPTION_TYPES_SERVER = (AES256), or TCPS only with TLS 1.2+
Unix audit: content check on sqlnet.ora
Encryption at rest (TDE)
Databases classified Confidential or higher use TDE tablespace encryption with the keystore outside the data files.
Keystore OPEN in v$encryption_wallet; user tablespaces ENCRYPTED = YES
Query v$encryption_wallet and DBA_TABLESPACES
Tenable cannot see data classification; scope comes from the CMDB.
Unified auditing policies
Unified auditing records logons, privilege use and security-relevant changes and is forwarded to the SIEM.
Policies enabled in AUDIT_UNIFIED_ENABLED_POLICIES cover LOGON / LOGOFF, ORA_SECURECONFIG, ORA_ACCOUNT_MGMT, ORA_DATABASE_PARAMETER
Query AUDIT_UNIFIED_ENABLED_POLICIES
SIEM forwarding is confirmed manually by the SOC.
